source_ols: OLS including intercept and only predictors explicitly listed in each source operator

joint_ols.reference: Population linear projection derived from the presealed artificial covariance

coefficient_error: (synthetic_coefficient - population_coefficient) * population_predictor_SD / population_outcome_SD; report signed and absolute values by term
residual_error: log(synthetic_residual_SD / population_residual_SD); report signed and absolute
aggregation: For each constructor, mean and range of each metric over the three fixed seeds. Arm summaries average its two constructor means with equal weight; report all constructors. No hypothesis test or claimed clinical tolerance.
new_gate: No clinical pass/fail or post-hoc acceptance margin. Deterministic source/law consistency can additionally be inspected as implementation verification; this is not proof of a fully identified distribution.
cost: Native subagent service; no new paid API. Exact backend snapshot and token cost unavailable. Record dispatch and submission clocks, not inferred human time saved.
